technical.summary: MET shows solid bullish structure with price above all key MAs and three white soldiers pattern, but weak trend strength (low ADX) and negative MACD histogram limit conviction for a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MET shows no fundamental conviction signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest, compounded by earnings announcement in 1 day creating elevated volatility risk.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; broad market fear (38/100) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and mixed recent trades (2 sales, 1 purchase by junior member) provide insufficient conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (317.44) combined with earnings binary event in 1 day creates severe near-term volatility risk for MET despite normal yield curve.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with three white soldiers pattern and bullish supertrend provides technical structure, while broad market fear (38/100) creates potential contrarian opportunity for swing entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings announcement in 1 day creates binary volatility risk that overwhelms technical setup; weak trend confirmation (ADX 18.78), negative MACD histogram, zero fundamental conviction, and VIX crisis regime (317.44) make this a high-risk, low-probability entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is constructive with price above all major MAs and three white soldiers pattern, but this is completely negated by earnings binary event in 1 day and VIX crisis regime creating unmanageable volatility risk.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement tomorrow will trigger gap risk and volatility spike that invalidates swing trade thesis; VIX at crisis levels (317.44) amplifies downside exposure.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already 39 positions in Financials sector; adding MET increases concentration risk without fundamental or smart money conviction to justify it.
